title: MiaoMiao Battery status at home screen?
body:
I can't get MiaoMiao battery status at the main screen as I do with Blucon. Is it possible to add this info? Instead of going to System Status - BT Device page.

Thanks

comments.body: I'd like to have that too.

And a warning Battery Low at 30%, so it has communicated to me the Chinese manufacturer.
I would be happy, thank you.

@tzachi-dar  @jamorham Something you can look into? This should be trivial to implement, looking at blukon.java the only thing you would have to set is Pref.setInt("bridge_battery", X);
I don't know if having the battery value stored both in PersistentStore (like tomato does now) and in Pref is the correct thing to do here (this should maybe be unified?)
maybe another candidate for the common class?
Is this MM battery status now included in the latest nightly build? - I am still running 20180530

@parapenT1sta Was this implemented?  Can we close this issue?
Thanks
@Navid200 Yes. It was. :) Closing the ticket.
